values.meaning: knock up (airborne) duration on the final target
delay into the grab before damage is dealt
values.quote: dealing {{as|physical damage}} after {{fd|0.75}} seconds into the grab duration
values.binNote: No bin data value for this timing exists in the sheet; the 0.75s delay is only stated in the wiki description text, distinct numerically from SecondaryTargetStunDuration which happens to share the value.

mechanics.claim: Enemies Vi dashes through take the same damage as the primary target and are stunned, as a separate instance for each target hit.
mechanics.quote: Enemies she dashes through are dealt the same damage, {{tip|airborne|knocked aside}} by 350 units over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Secondary targets cannot be hit again by the dash for about 4 seconds after being affected.
mechanics.quote: Secondary targets will be affected as soon as they come into contact with '''Vi''', and cannot be affected by this again for ~4 seconds.

mechanics.claim: If the target becomes untargetable during the dash, Vi ends the dash and can apply airborne without dealing damage.
mechanics.quote: If '''Vi''' enters grabbing range, she will apply the {{tip|airborne}} effect but not deal any damage.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast, not on hit or landing.
Vault Breaker (Q) is disabled while Cease and Desist is dashing, but Relentless Force (E) remains usable.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Relentless Force|Vi}} is usable. {{ai|Vault Breaker|Vi}} is disabled.
